hooks.command:
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { ml=$(bash .github/mount-from-lock.sh --root . 2>&1) || printf '⚠️ mount-from-lock did not lay down every pinned layer, so this session may run on tools older than index.lock.json: %s— run `bun run cat mount:lock` for the full report
' "$(printf '%s
' "$ml" | grep -E '^ *(missing|could-not-determine) ' | head -3 | sed -E 's/  +/ /g' | tr '
' ';')"; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1; bash cat-harness-tools/scripts/session-start-coord-sweep.sh; }
